digest.component_or_area: live jira dc integration harness and reconciler mutations
propositions: rebar must reconcile bidirectionally against a real jira datacenter instance using a copy of this project's actual ticket store, not an empty repository, to prove data moves in both directions
the working repository must be isolated from production by having no git remotes, no push capability, and no cloud credentials, verified by test rather than assumed

the copied store must be scrubbed of all reconciler artifacts matching the pattern .bridge_state* and jira bindings before any reconciliation pass runs, with completeness asserted by filesystem inspection

the suite must assert each of 28 mutations individually with oracles that read values back from the instance after the pass, not by counting convergence or absence of exceptions, to catch silent failures like soft-error handling
pagination must be measured against the actual server-reported page size and seeded at 2*observed+1 to force multiple pages, with all seeded issues recovered as evidence

the inbound and outbound paths each have a category of defects where dc silently accepts writes that have no effect, requiring direct oracle reads from the instance rather than pass-level convergence assertions to detect them
